from pathlib import Path
import csv, hashlib, json, subprocess, sys, tempfile
root = Path('products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example')
fixtures = root / 'fixtures'
original = fixtures / 'after-shopify.csv'
raw = original.read_bytes()
lines = raw.splitlines(keepends=True)
header = next(csv.reader([lines[0].decode()]))
barcode_col = header.index('Barcodes')
sku_col = header.index('SKU')
rows = list(csv.reader(raw.decode().splitlines()))
assert len(rows) == len(lines), 'Fixture contains multiline CSV records'
selected = [(i, row[sku_col], row[barcode_col]) for i, row in enumerate(rows[1:], start=1) if row[sku_col] and row[barcode_col]]
left, right = next((a, b) for a in selected for b in selected if a[0] < b[0] and a[2] != b[2])
changed = lines.copy()
for current, other in ((left, right), (right, left)):
    index, sku, old = current
    assert old.isascii() and old.isdigit() and other[2].isascii() and other[2].isdigit()
    assert changed[index].count(old.encode()) == 1, 'Barcode text is ambiguous on the fixture line'
    changed[index] = changed[index].replace(old.encode(), other[2].encode(), 1)
mutated = b''.join(changed)
new_rows = list(csv.reader(mutated.decode().splitlines()))
diffs = [(i, j, old, new) for i, (before, after) in enumerate(zip(rows, new_rows)) for j, (old, new) in enumerate(zip(before, after)) if old != new]
assert len(new_rows) == len(rows) and all(len(a) == len(b) for a, b in zip(rows, new_rows))
assert diffs == [(left[0], barcode_col, left[2], right[2]), (right[0], barcode_col, right[2], left[2])]
def run(path):
    command = [sys.executable, str(root / 'verify_example.py'), str(fixtures / 'before-variants.csv'), str(fixtures / 'before-images.csv'), str(path)]
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
    return {'exit': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    candidate = Path(directory) / 'after-shopify.csv'
    candidate.write_bytes(mutated)
    baseline, swap = run(original), run(candidate)
try:
    failures = json.loads(swap['stdout']).get('failed')
except (ValueError, AttributeError):
    failures = None
report = {'scope': 'Fictional worked-example fixtures. Offline verifier only.', 'fixture_changes': [{'csv_line': i + 1, 'sku': rows[i][sku_col], 'field': header[j], 'before': old, 'after': new} for i, j, old, new in diffs], 'source_sha256': {str(p.relative_to(root)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (root / 'verify_example.py', root / 'verify.py', fixtures / 'before-variants.csv', fixtures / 'before-images.csv')}, 'baseline': baseline, 'swap': swap, 'isolated_grouped_failure': baseline['exit'] == 0 and swap['exit'] == 1 and failures == ['identifiers_preserved_sku_barcode_color_size_price']}
output = Path('products/services/stream-commerce-catalogue/director-barcode-swap-exact-cells.json')
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print(output.read_text())
